primary.label: Primary estimate
primary.note: Clients who closed without a logged UC date count as reaching UC, placed the typical UC-to-close gap before their closing. Paused and refunded clients stay in as not having reached it.

alternatives.label: Latest possible contract date
alternatives.note: Clients who closed without a logged contract date are placed at their inspection date, or their closing if no inspection is logged.

alternatives.label: Earlier contract date (60-day gap)
alternatives.note: Places those clients 60 days before closing, the 90th percentile of the contract-to-close gap.

alternatives.label: Paused and refunded clients can never reach it
alternatives.note: Treats every pause or refund as permanent.

alternatives.label: Paused and refunded clients leave when they exit
alternatives.note: Assumes they would have progressed like everyone else. Too optimistic; not used for the range.

alternatives.label: Only clients who started since Jul 2025
alternatives.note: Leaves out the early period, where Jira history is incomplete.

prior.label: As previously reported
prior.note: Counts clients who closed without a logged UC date as still waiting.

primary.note: Clients in a closed or post-close status with no logged CLOSED date are left out. Paused and refunded clients stay in as not having reached it.
